title: joserfc: Unbounded JWE General JSON `recipients` Array Leads to CPU Exhaustion (DoS) via Repeated RSA Private-Key…
description: The joserfc library's JWE General JSON decryption function accepts an attacker-controlled recipients array of unbounded length, causing the library to perform one RSA private-key decryption operation per recipient without limit. This leads to a CPU exhaustion denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability. The documented mitigation option does not reduce CPU usage, and no upper bound check exists on the number of recipients. The vulnerability is fixed in version 3.4.2_1.
